meta.name: schema
meta.description: Use when adding, fixing, or reviewing structured data: JSON-LD for articles, products, FAQs, breadcrumbs, organizations, and local businesses, and what to do when markup doesn't earn a rich result.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为网页添加结构化数据,让搜索结果展示摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想让网站内容在搜索结果中以更亮眼的形式呈现
copy.tagline_en: Add structured data markup to pages for richer search snippets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your website to show richer search results

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能帮你生成、修改或检查网页的JSON-LD结构化数据，例如文章、产品、组织等类型。它会核对必填属性、日期和链接格式，并给出可粘贴的代码和官方验证工具链接。
howto.when: 当你说要添加、修复或检查网页的结构化数据（如文章、产品、FAQ等），或问为什么标记没获得丰富结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我的博客文章加上Article类型的JSON-LD标记。
say.note: Claude会生成完整代码块，并检查必填项。

say.text: 这段产品数据的JSON-LD为什么没有丰富结果？
用脚本验证一下这个JSON-LD文件的格式是否合规。
say.note: Claude会运行验证并报告语法与格式问题。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create, fix, or review JSON-LD structured data for articles, products, etc. It validates required fields, date/link formats, and hands over paste-ready code with official validator links.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add, fix, or check structured data (articles, products, FAQs, etc.) or ask why markup didn't earn a rich result.

say_en.text: Add Article JSON-LD markup to my blog post.
say_en.note: Claude produces a complete code block and checks required fields.

say_en.text: Why isn't my product JSON-LD getting a rich result?
say_en.note: Claude walks through possible causes in order.

say_en.text: Run the validator on this JSON-LD file for format issues.
say_en.note: Claude checks syntax and common format problems.
